title: Introduce Companion RAG Playbook: browser embedder + WASM shim
author: Lina Park
description:
Motivation: provide a minimal, production-adjacent example that demonstrates how to embed a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) companion UI inside single-page browser apps while running a small WASM-based shim for local index access and telemetry probes. This PR bundles an opinionated playbook, a browser embedder (vanilla JS + tiny iframe shim), a Rust->WASM micro-shim for light-weight local indexing and signing, and docs showing how to wire Redwood streaming + structured output validation.

What changed (high-level):
- new example: examples/companion-rag-playbook (playbook, snippets, smoke tests)
- browser embedder: examples/companion-rag-playbook/web/embedder (no framework dependency, drop-in iframe)
- wasm shim: src/shims/wasm-indexer (Rust->wasm example and simple build script)
- docs: docs/examples/companion-rag-playbook.md with quickstart and troubleshooting
- telemetry: added compact probe presets and a short dashboard JSON for Redwood Console ingestion

Checklist: 
- [x] Playbook and README with end-to-end quickstart
- [x] Minimal browser embedder and example host page
- [x] WASM shim source and build instructions (cargo + wasm-pack)
- [x] Basic smoke tests (headless browser) and CI job added
- [x] Structured output linter example included

Why this is useful: many teams want to progressively enhance web apps with RAG features without shipping a full backend. The companion pattern here shows how to keep the heavy lifting on Redwood while allowing a local lightweight WASM shim for offline index reads, smaller latency for prefix lookups, and safer key handling patterns (one-way signing). The example also demonstrates telemetry probes tied to session IDs and token counts so teams can reproduce cost/latency in a dev environment.

Related: Linear ENG-2143 (companion pattern spec), DOCS-87 (docs task), RFC: wasm-shims-for-light-indexing (internal link).

review_comments:
Aran: Nice pattern — can we avoid shipping secret material to the browser by default? Suggest adding example for one-way signing and rotating ephemeral keys.
Author: added section in README and docs describing a one-way signing flow and an env var to toggle the shim's network-only mode.

Maya: The wasm build instructions assume wasm-pack; some contributors use trunk or cargo + wasm-bindgen-cli. Can we add a quick alternative?
Author: added alternate build section that uses cargo + wasm-bindgen-cli and included a small Makefile target.

Theo: Telemetry presets look good; request is to ensure session IDs are PII-free and hashed. Also add a retention note.
Author: updated probe to hash session IDs and added retention guidance and console dashboard README.

Maya: small nit on embedder messaging contract — include timeout and error fallback pattern.
Author: updated embedder.js with a 6s response timeout and documented fallback to server-side proxy in the README.
release_notes: Add 'Companion RAG Playbook' example: browser embedder + WASM shim for offline/lightweight indexing, docs and CI smoke tests. Useful for teams wanting a minimal client-first RAG integration pattern.
